description: Places de stationnement pour les personnes à mobilité réduite au Poinçonnet is a dataset listed in data.centrevaldeloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville du Poinçonnet. Places de stationnement pour personne à mobilité en centre-ville du Poinçonnet en 2026. Coverage: Centre-Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are stationnement, mobilité réduite, PMR, handicap, 36159, Publié par la collectivité. The portal shows 27 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-02-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-centrevaldeloire-fr-portal.
